name: immediate-execution
description: Calculator evaluates strictly left to right with no operator precedence (2 + 3 × 4 = 20); project-wide decision
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 705e51b4-3524-472d-917f-886debebac4a
  modified: 2026-09-13T02:45:59.825Z
---

The calculator uses immediate execution. Each operator key finishes the waiting operation, left to right. No operator precedence: `2 + 3 × 4 =` is `20`.

**Why:** It matches a pocket calculator and keeps the running display honest. The number on screen is always a real result the calculator will use.

**How to apply:** Every future feature (memory keys, percent, sign toggle, backspace, history) must fit this model. Never add a parser or precedence. Decided 2026-09-12.

Parentheses (added 2026-09-12) fit this model: `(` saves the waiting operation on a stack and starts a fresh left-to-right calculation; `)` finishes it and the result becomes the entry; `=` closes any open groups. No expression parsing.
---
name: number-presentation
description: Rounding is render-time only; max 10 sig digits, no trailing zeros, exp notation at >=1e10 or <1e-9; data-value stays exact
metadata:
  type: project
---

Decided 2026-09-12, holds for the rest of the calculator project.
- Display rounds to at most 10 significant digits, drops trailing zeros and a trailing ".". No thousands separators.
- Exponential notation only when magnitude >= 1e10 or < 1e-9.
- Stored/computed value is never rounded. `data-value` on `calc-display` always carries the exact value.
- While typing, show the entry exactly as typed.
- Division by zero: display `Error`, `data-error="true"`, all keys but clear ignored; clear resets to `0`. `data-error` is always present.

**Why:** Rounding stored values compounds through chains; `2 ÷ 3 × 3 =` must be exactly `2`.
**How to apply:** Never add rounding/cleaning in compute paths; format only in render. Related: [[immediate-execution]].
---
name: tape
description: Running tape of past calculations; which equals presses add a row and how expressions are written
metadata:
  type: project
---

Tape added 2026-09-12. Newest row first; row = expression + result only.
- A row is added only when `=` actually computes: an operation, a repeated `=`, or a group result like `(2 + 3) =`. A lone `5 =` adds nothing. `÷0` adds nothing.
- Expression is built from tokens as keys are pressed, not parsed: operators shown as `+ − × ÷`, numbers via the display formatter, groups as `(3 × 4)`, ± on a group as `-(2 + 3)`. `5 + =` shows `5 + 5`; repeated `=` shows `last result op operand`.
- `tape-result` `data-value` is exact (`String(value)`), text is formatted. AC does not clear the tape; Clear does not touch the display.

**Why:** Keeps the tape honest to [[immediate-execution]] and [[number-presentation]].
**How to apply:** New keys that change the entry must keep `state.tokens` / `state.entryExpr` in sync.

<script>
(function () {
  var display = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calc-display"]');
  var groupsEl = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calc-groups"]');
  var opButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-op]');
  var tape = document.querySelector('[data-testid="calc-tape"]');
  var tapeEmpty = document.querySelector('.tape-empty');
  var opSymbols = { '+': '+', '-': '−', '*': '×', '/': '÷' };

  var state;

  function reset() {
    state = {
      entry: '0',        // text of the number being typed
      value: 0,          // exact current value when not typing; never rounded
      stored: null,      // left operand
      op: null,          // pending operator
      typing: false,     // true while the user is building an entry
      edited: false,     // true when ± or ) turned the display into the entry
      lastOp: null,      // for repeated equals
      lastOperand: null,
      groups: [],        // one saved {stored, op, tokens} per open parenthesis
      tokens: [],        // expression text so far at this group level; ends with op when op is set
      entryExpr: null,   // expression text for an entry made by ), e.g. "(3 × 4)"
      error: false
    };
  }

  function compute(a, op, b) {
    switch (op) {
      case '+': return a + b;
      case '-': return a - b;
      case '*': return a * b;
      case '/': return b === 0 ? NaN : a / b;
    }
    return b;
  }

  function currentValue() {
    return state.typing ? parseFloat(state.entry) : state.value;
  }

  // True when the display holds an entry: typed, or changed by ± or ).
  function hasEntry() {
    return state.typing || state.edited;
  }

  // Expression text for the current entry, for the tape.
  function entryText() {
    return state.entryExpr !== null ? state.entryExpr : format(currentValue());
  }

  function addTapeRow(expr, n) {
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'tape-row';
    row.setAttribute('data-testid', 'tape-row');
    var e = document.createElement('span');
    e.className = 'tape-expr';
    e.setAttribute('data-testid', 'tape-expr');
    e.textContent = expr;
    var r = document.createElement('span');
    r.className = 'tape-result';
    r.setAttribute('data-testid', 'tape-result');
    r.setAttribute('data-value', String(n));
    r.textContent = format(n);
    row.appendChild(e);
    row.appendChild(r);
    tape.insertBefore(row, tape.firstChild);
    tape.scrollTop = 0;
    tapeEmpty.hidden = true;
  }

  function clearTape() {
    tape.textContent = '';
    tapeEmpty.hidden = false;
  }

  // Presentation only: at most 10 significant digits, no trailing zeros,
  // exponential notation when |n| >= 1e10 or |n| < 1e-9. Never feed the
  // result back into a calculation.
  function format(n) {
    var m = Math.abs(n).toExponential(9).match(/^(\d)\.(\d+)e([+-]\d+)$/);
    var digits = m[1] + m[2];
    var exp = parseInt(m[3], 10);
    var sign = n < 0 ? '-' : '';
    var intPart, frac;
    if (Number(digits) === 0) return '0';
    if (exp >= 10 || exp < -9) {
      frac = m[2].replace(/0+$/, '');
      return sign + m[1] + (frac ? '.' + frac : '') + 'e' + (exp < 0 ? '-' : '+') + Math.abs(exp);
    }
    if (exp >= 0) {
      intPart = digits.slice(0, exp + 1);
      frac = digits.slice(exp + 1);
    } else {
      intPart = '0';
      frac = new Array(-exp).join('0') + digits;
    }
    frac = frac.replace(/0+$/, '');
    return sign + intPart + (frac ? '.' + frac : '');
  }

  function render() {
    var text, value;
    if (state.error) {
      text = 'Error';
      value = 'NaN';
    } else {
      value = currentValue();
      text = state.typing ? state.entry : format(value);
      value = String(value);
    }
    display.textContent = text;
    display.setAttribute('data-value', value);
    display.setAttribute('data-error', state.error ? 'true' : 'false');
    display.setAttribute('data-open-groups', String(state.groups.length));
    groupsEl.textContent = new Array(state.groups.length + 1).join('(');
    display.classList.toggle('small', text.length > 9 && text.length <= 13);
    display.classList.toggle('tiny', text.length > 13);
    for (var i = 0; i < opButtons.length; i++) {
      var b = opButtons[i];
      b.classList.toggle('active', !hasEntry() && state.op === b.getAttribute('data-op'));
    }
  }

  function setResult(n) {
    if (!isFinite(n)) {
      reset();
      state.error = true;
    } else {
      state.value = n;
    }
  }

  function inputDigit(d) {
    if (!state.typing) {
      state.entry = d;
      state.typing = true;
      state.edited = false;
      state.entryExpr = null;
      if (state.op === null) state.lastOp = null;
    } else if (state.entry === '0' || state.entry === '-0') {
      state.entry = state.entry.slice(0, -1) + d;
    } else if (state.entry.replace(/[-.]/g, '').length < 16) {
      state.entry += d;
    }
  }

  function inputDot() {
    if (!state.typing) {
      state.entry = '0.';
      state.typing = true;
      state.edited = false;
      state.entryExpr = null;
      if (state.op === null) state.lastOp = null;
    } else if (state.entry.indexOf('.') === -1) {
      state.entry += '.';
    }
  }

  // ± acts on the current entry at once. While typing, ± keeps the
  // entry editable. Otherwise the displayed value becomes the entry, so
  // after an operator it is the right operand: 5 + ± = is 0.
  function toggleSign() {
    if (state.typing) {
      state.entry = state.entry.charAt(0) === '-' ? state.entry.slice(1) : '-' + state.entry;
    } else if (state.value === 0) {
      // Start a negative entry: ± 5 is -5.
      state.entry = '-0';
      state.typing = true;
      state.edited = false;
      state.entryExpr = null;
      if (state.op === null) state.lastOp = null;
    } else {
      state.value = -state.value;
      state.edited = true;
      if (state.entryExpr !== null) {
        state.entryExpr = state.entryExpr.charAt(0) === '-' ? state.entryExpr.slice(1) : '-' + state.entryExpr;
      }
    }
  }

  // Immediate execution, strictly left to right, no operator precedence:
  // 2 + 3 × 4 = is 20. An operator key first finishes the operation already
  // waiting, so the display always shows a real running result.
  function inputOp(op) {
    var v = currentValue();
    var text = entryText();
    if (state.op !== null && hasEntry()) {
      setResult(compute(state.stored, state.op, v));
      if (state.error) return;
      state.tokens.push(text, opSymbols[op]);
    } else if (state.op !== null) {
      // Replacing the waiting operator.
      state.value = v;
      state.tokens[state.tokens.length - 1] = opSymbols[op];
    } else {
      state.value = v;
      state.tokens = [text, opSymbols[op]];
    }
    state.stored = state.value;
    state.op = op;
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = false;
    state.entryExpr = null;
    state.lastOp = null;
  }

  // Parentheses keep immediate execution. ( saves the waiting operation and
  // starts a fresh calculation, like a new number would. ) finishes that
  // calculation, restores the saved operation, and leaves the group result
  // as the entry: 2 + ( 3 × 4 ) = is 14. Groups nest.
  function openGroup() {
    state.groups.push({ stored: state.stored, op: state.op, tokens: state.tokens });
    state.stored = null;
    state.op = null;
    state.tokens = [];
    state.value = 0;
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = false;
    state.entryExpr = null;
    state.lastOp = null;
  }

  function closeGroup() {
    if (state.groups.length === 0) return;
    var inner;
    if (state.op !== null && hasEntry()) {
      inner = state.tokens.concat(entryText());
      setResult(compute(state.stored, state.op, currentValue()));
      if (state.error) return;
    } else {
      // A trailing operator with no operand is dropped: ( 2 + ) is 2.
      inner = state.op !== null ? state.tokens.slice(0, -1) : [entryText()];
      state.value = currentValue();
    }
    var saved = state.groups.pop();
    state.stored = saved.stored;
    state.op = saved.op;
    state.tokens = saved.tokens;
    state.entryExpr = '(' + inner.join(' ') + ')';
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = true;
    state.lastOp = null;
  }

  function equals() {
    // = closes any groups still open.
    while (state.groups.length > 0 && !state.error) closeGroup();
    if (state.error) return;
    var expr = null;
    if (state.op !== null) {
      var b = hasEntry() ? currentValue() : state.stored;
      expr = state.tokens.concat(hasEntry() ? entryText() : format(b));
      state.lastOp = state.op;
      state.lastOperand = b;
      setResult(compute(state.stored, state.op, b));
    } else if (state.lastOp !== null) {
      // Repeated equals: apply the last operation again.
      expr = [entryText(), opSymbols[state.lastOp], format(state.lastOperand)];
      setResult(compute(currentValue(), state.lastOp, state.lastOperand));
    } else {
      // A lone number is not a calculation; a group result is.
      if (hasEntry() && state.entryExpr !== null) expr = [state.entryExpr];
      state.value = currentValue();
    }
    if (state.error) return;
    if (expr !== null) addTapeRow(expr.join(' '), state.value);
    state.op = null;
    state.stored = null;
    state.tokens = [];
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = false;
    state.entryExpr = null;
  }

  function handle(el) {
    var digit = el.getAttribute('data-digit');
    var op = el.getAttribute('data-op');
    var action = el.getAttribute('data-action');
    // In the error state only clear does anything.
    if (state.error && action !== 'clear') return;
    if (digit !== null) inputDigit(digit);
    else if (op !== null) inputOp(op);
    else if (action === 'dot') inputDot();
    else if (action === 'sign') toggleSign();
    else if (action === 'lparen') openGroup();
    else if (action === 'rparen') closeGroup();
    else if (action === 'equals') equals();
    else if (action === 'clear') reset();
    render();
  }

  document.querySelector('.keys').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest('button');
    if (el) handle(el);
  });

  document.querySelector('[data-testid="tape-clear"]').addEventListener('click', clearTape);

  var keyMap = {
    '+': 'key-add', '-': 'key-sub', '*': 'key-mul', 'x': 'key-mul', '/': 'key-div',
    '.': 'key-dot', '(': 'key-lparen', ')': 'key-rparen', ',': 'key-dot', '=': 'key-equals', 'Enter': 'key-equals',
    'Escape': 'key-clear', 'c': 'key-clear', 'C': 'key-clear', 'Delete': 'key-clear'
  };
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
    var id = /^[0-9]$/.test(e.key) ? 'key-' + e.key : keyMap[e.key];
    if (!id) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    handle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="' + id + '"]'));
  });

  reset();
  render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

      state.tokens = [text, opSymbols[op]];
    }
    state.stored = state.value;
    state.op = op;
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = false;
    state.entryExpr = null;
    state.lastOp = null;
  }

  // Parentheses keep immediate execution. ( saves the waiting operation and
  // starts a fresh calculation, like a new number would. ) finishes that
  // calculation, restores the saved operation, and leaves the group result
  // as the entry: 2 + ( 3 × 4 ) = is 14. Groups nest.
  function openGroup() {
    state.groups.push({ stored: state.stored, op: state.op, tokens: state.tokens });
    state.stored = null;
    state.op = null;
    state.tokens = [];
    state.value = 0;
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = false;
    state.entryExpr = null;
    state.lastOp = null;
  }

  function closeGroup() {
    if (state.groups.length === 0) return;
    var inner;
    if (state.op !== null && hasEntry()) {
      inner = state.tokens.concat(entryText());
      setResult(compute(state.stored, state.op, currentValue()));
      if (state.error) return;
    } else {
      // A trailing operator with no operand is dropped: ( 2 + ) is 2.
      inner = state.op !== null ? state.tokens.slice(0, -1) : [entryText()];
      state.value = currentValue();
    }
    var saved = state.groups.pop();
    state.stored = saved.stored;
    state.op = saved.op;
    state.tokens = saved.tokens;
    state.entryExpr = '(' + inner.join(' ') + ')';
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = true;
    state.lastOp = null;
  }

  function equals() {
    // = closes any groups still open.
    while (state.groups.length > 0 && !state.error) closeGroup();
    if (state.error) return;
    var expr = null;
    if (state.op !== null) {
      var b = hasEntry() ? currentValue() : state.stored;
      expr = state.tokens.concat(hasEntry() ? entryText() : format(b));
      state.lastOp = state.op;
      state.lastOperand = b;
      setResult(compute(state.stored, state.op, b));
    } else if (state.lastOp !== null) {
      // Repeated equals: apply the last operation again.
      expr = [entryText(), opSymbols[state.lastOp], format(state.lastOperand)];
      setResult(compute(currentValue(), state.lastOp, state.lastOperand));
    } else {
      // A lone number is not a calculation; a group result is.
      if (hasEntry() && state.entryExpr !== null) expr = [state.entryExpr];
      state.value = currentValue();
    }
    if (state.error) return;
    if (expr !== null) addTapeRow(expr.join(' '), state.value);
    state.op = null;
    state.stored = null;
    state.tokens = [];
    state.typing = false;
    state.edited = false;
    state.entryExpr = null;
  }

  function handle(el) {
    var digit = el.getAttribute('data-digit');
    var op = el.getAttribute('data-op');
    var action = el.getAttribute('data-action');
    // In the error state only clear does anything.
    if (state.error && action !== 'clear') return;
    if (digit !== null) inputDigit(digit);
    else if (op !== null) inputOp(op);
    else if (action === 'dot') inputDot();
    else if (action === 'sign') toggleSign();
    else if (action === 'lparen') openGroup();
    else if (action === 'rparen') closeGroup();
    else if (action === 'equals') equals();
    else if (action === 'clear') reset();
    render();
  }

  document.querySelector('.keys').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest('button');
    if (el) handle(el);
  });

  document.querySelector('[data-testid="tape-clear"]').addEventListener('click', clearTape);

  var keyMap = {
    '+': 'key-add', '-': 'key-sub', '*': 'key-mul', 'x': 'key-mul', '/': 'key-div',
    '.': 'key-dot', '(': 'key-lparen', ')': 'key-rparen', ',': 'key-dot', '=': 'key-equals', 'Enter': 'key-equals',
    'Escape': 'key-clear', 'c': 'key-clear', 'C': 'key-clear', 'Delete': 'key-clear'
  };
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
    var id = /^[0-9]$/.test(e.key) ? 'key-' + e.key : keyMap[e.key];
    if (!id) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    handle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="' + id + '"]'));
  });

  reset();
  render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

I couldn't reproduce the bug, so I didn't change anything.

**What I tested.** I drove `index.html` in headless Chrome with both clicks and the keyboard:

| Keys | Display | Tape row |
|---|---|---|
| `0.1 + 0.2 =` | 0.3 | 0.1 + 0.2 → 0.3 |
| `1 ÷ 3 =` | 0.3333333333 | 1 ÷ 3 → 0.3333333333 |
| `0.1 + 0.2 = + =` | 0.6 | 0.3 + 0.3 → 0.6 |
| `1 ÷ 3 = =` | 0.1111111111 | 0.3333333333 ÷ 3 → 0.1111111111 |
| `(0.1 + 0.2) × 3 =` | 0.9 | (0.1 + 0.2) × 3 → 0.9 |

I also ran 20,000 random key sequences. No tape row showed a number longer than the 10 significant digits the formatter allows.

**The code agrees.** The tape and the display use the same formatter (`index.html:239` and `index.html:284`). That has been true since the tape was added in batch 07. No earlier version had a tape, so an old cached copy can't explain it either.

**Where `0.30000000000000004` does exist.** It's in the `data-value` attribute on each tape result (`index.html:238`). You can't see it on the page, but it shows up in browser dev tools, in test scripts and in scraped HTML. It's exact on purpose, like the display's `data-value`, so rounding never builds up across calculations. If the reporter was reading the page through one of those, that's what they saw.

What would help:
- If they saw it on the page itself, I need their browser and the exact keys they pressed.
- If they were reading `data-value`, it's working as designed. I could add a second attribute holding the formatted text, but I'd keep `data-value` exact.
